name: 9 oz Vanilla Latte
caffeineNote: Wegmans’ product listing states 100 mg of caffeine per can; the nutrition panel has no caffeine row
summary: The four-pack version of Wegmans’ own-brand vanilla latte, from its product listing and not yet checked against a can: the same recipe as the 11 oz single, cold brew with lactose-free whole milk, cane sugar and vanilla extract, in a 9 oz can. Wegmans lists 100 mg of caffeine, 130 calories, 12 g of sugar (4 g added) and 6 g of protein per can, at $8.99 for four.
